name: SuperTrend + ADX combined confirmation
description: Tests whether combining SuperTrend with ADX (trend-strength confirmation) improves on SuperTrend-alone results (9 trades/-2.86%/-6.26 Sharpe with require_trend=false; 6 trades/0% win rate/-49.91 Sharpe with require_trend=true).
hypothesis: SuperTrend alone has no durable edge on BTC/USDT 1h; adding an ADX confirmation filter should reduce entries during weak/choppy trends and improve win rate and Sharpe.
